prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Promethium (Pm) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one horizontal 3:2 image, 1536×1024.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a mine gallery of rough rock walls, timber props, an ore cart on its track and a line of hanging lamps
Time of day: cool white overhead light, flat and bright; flat white light with crisp edges, no warm glow.
Hair: her hair let down loose over her shoulders — same colour and length as the attached image.
Outfit: an Andean woven layer — a striped handwoven poncho over a pollera skirt and a felt hat; styled with tone-on-tone embroidery, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: an environmental long shot, her complete figure and enough of the place around her; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the left of the frame, so her own left side is toward the camera; camera at her eye level; she is small in the lower part of the frame, the place rising above her.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP — her near arm, on the camera side.
PROP: with both hands she holds a palm-sized glass lantern holding a single bead that glows a soft blue-green on its own in both hands in front of her — her own right hand holds one side, her own left hand holds the other side.
LEGS: weight even on both legs.
EXPRESSION: relaxed brow, softly open eyes, lips closed and unstrained, no smile.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — promethium: the long-missing element 61, a gap in the table foretold for decades and falsely claimed again and again, never truly found in nature because not one of its forms is stable; finally caught in 1945 in the ashes of split uranium inside a wartime reactor laboratory and named for the titan who stole fire from the gods and gave it to people, a reminder of both daring and danger; its pink salts glow on their own a pale blue-green in the dark, so it became the self-luminous paint on watch hands and signs, and the tiny atomic battery that kept early heart pacemakers beating for years without light or fuel — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: keep her exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text or numbers other than her element's own symbol and atomic number, no logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.
